column2: Gap Matrix: PRISM-LEO layer x attack category

Live counts of Threat Atlas entries. Red cells (0) are gaps: no source of any kind covers that layer and attack category. Matrix C keeps only practical evidence (E2 real hardware/field, E3 operational), so a non-red cell in A or B can still be red in C.
A. By entry layer (where the attacker's input first acts)
B. By impact layer (furthest layer the source shows the attack reaching)
C. By impact layer, practical evidence only (E2 + E3)

Note (29 Oct 2026): the L3 rows above are empty by design, since no published source enters at L3 or targets a CVE-listed L3 component. The seven L3 assets (A3.1 to A3.7) are listed in the Asset Register sheet and in Overview section 7b, with the sources whose bound attacks reach them.
